metadata.name: Deployment & Infrastructure Security Core Infrastructure
metadata.description: Secure infrastructure deployment, hardening, and operational security for MailMyPDF services.

components: API Gateway (reverse proxy, rate limiting, WAF)
Database (encrypted at rest, read replicas for HA)
File storage (S3 with encryption, versioning, access logs)
Message queue (for async tasks: PDF processing, mailing)

network.dmz: Bastion host for SSH access; no direct database access
network.separation: App tier cannot directly access encryption keys (via KMS API only)
network.firewall: Strict ingress/egress rules; allow only necessary ports

hosting.regions: Deploy in US + EU (legal data residency requirements)

containerization.requirement: All services run in containers (Docker) for consistent, secure deployment

imageScanning.requirement: No high/critical vulnerabilities in base image or dependencies

baseImages.recommendation: Use minimal base images (Alpine Linux, Distroless)
baseImages.avoidance: Never use 'latest' tag; always pin specific version

secrets.rule: Never hardcode secrets in Dockerfile or image
secrets.method: Inject via environment variables or secrets management system

infrastructure-as-code.requirement: All infrastructure defined in code (Terraform, CloudFormation)
securityChecks: No hardcoded credentials in IaC files

process.cicd: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or AWS CodePipeline
steps: 10. Deploy to production (canary or blue-green deployment)

approvals.production: Manual: security engineer + tech lead required

deployment.rollback: Automated rollback if health checks fail after deployment

serverHardening.osUpdates: Automatic security patches; reboot out-of-hours weekly
firewallRules: Allow only: SSH (from bastion only), HTTPS (port 443), health checks

sshAccess.method: SSH key authentication only; no passwords
sshAccess.bastion: SSH via bastion host only (jump host)

serverHardening.packageManagement: Remove unnecessary packages; use minimal OS images
serverHardening.selinux: Enable SELinux in enforcing mode (if using Linux)

networkSecurity.loadbalancing: Application load balancer (ALB) for HA and DDoS protection
networkSecurity.cdn: CloudFront or similar CDN for static assets; enables geo-blocking
networkSecurity.waf: Web Application Firewall (AWS WAF) to block malicious requests
networkSecurity.ddosProtection: AWS Shield or Cloudflare DDoS protection

databaseSecurity.encryption: TLS for all connections to database

backups.testing: Monthly restore test to verify backup integrity

accessControl.rule: Database never directly accessible from internet
accessControl.method: Only accessible from application servers via private network
accessControl.auditLogging: Query logging enabled; slow query monitoring

logsAggregation.requirement: All logs centralized in immutable audit store
logsAggregation.retention: 7 years for audit logs; 30 days for application logs
logsAggregation.masking: PII and secrets never logged; use placeholders instead

examples: High error rate detected → Investigate cause, rollback if needed
Database unavailable → Failover to read replica, notify on-call
Suspicious API traffic → Block IP, investigate logs
Disk full → Scale storage, investigate log growth

requirements.name: ssl-test
requirements.method: SSL Labs test; verify A+ rating

requirements.name: firewall-test
requirements.method: Port scan; verify only expected ports open

requirements.name: backup-test
requirements.method: Restore backup to test environment; verify data integrity
